## ShadowFlow (Rootless) v2.0.1 · build 32

**Released:** October 6, 2026

### Changes
• Automation-only build: keychain handler and the alert / App Store / Settings automation hooks are gone — keyboard text input stays
• Home is now a services dashboard with an activity feed; proxy, RRS and backup sheets removed (proxy is owned by com.0x17.persona.proxy)
• Daemon drops the backup and wipe commands; RRS backups no longer touch the keychain
• Deployed rootless (Dopamine/palera1n); earlier builds kept in the repo

## ShadowFlow (Rootless) v2.0.1 · build 31

**Released:** September 17, 2026

### Changes
• App-level automation suite (keyboard input, alert auto-allow, App Store flows)
• sdflow:// URL scheme — group start/stop/restart
• Enhanced logging and status reporting
• Bug fixes and stability improvements

## ShadowFlow (Rootless) v2.0.0

**Released:** January 13, 2026

### Changes
• Complete rewrite with improved performance
• Added VNC remote access support
• Enhanced proxy management system
• Improved device spoofing capabilities
• Better compatibility with iOS 14-17
• Rootless jailbreak support (Dopamine, palera1n)
• Fixed various bugs and stability issues
